title: Recognise a Reason Without Pretending to Agree
status: New proposed Lesson 04 production script, 2026-10-29. No new animation or narration in this handoff.
learningOutcome: Acknowledge a genuinely relevant reason while stating a real reservation; distinguish recognition from agreement and avoid using personal judgements as objections.

scenario.task: Plan how a group will use an answer-help tool during a twenty-minute practice session with two sample problems. The aim is to understand the key reasoning, not merely finish answers.
conditions: The fictional tool can offer a hint or a worked answer
Tool output is not independently verified
scenario.baselineQuote: An answer tool can save time when we get stuck. I would use it as soon as a problem becomes difficult.
scenario.scope: No institution, official test, observed learner performance or measured outcome is represented. S07 transfers to a new event-notice layout discussion. The baseline quote does not specify whether the help is a hint or a full answer.

blocks.title: A Reason Can Matter without Settling the Decision
Keep Both Sides of the Reply Accurate

L04.S02.c001.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c001.text: Recognising a reason means showing that you have understood why it matters. It does not require accepting the proposal. You can be honest about both a useful consideration and a concern that remains.
L04.S02.c001.visualEn: Start with separate reason and proposal cards. Allow recognition of the reason while the proposal stays unresolved; no agreement tick or compulsory compliment bubble.
L04.S02.c001.anchorHint: It does not require accepting the proposal
L04.S02.c001.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c001.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c002.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c002.text: The group is planning twenty minutes with two sample problems. They want to understand the key reasoning. Their tool can show a hint or a full worked answer in this fictional case, but its output is unverified and no plan has been adopted.
L04.S02.c002.visualEn: Restore task facts for standalone viewing. Keep help modes unselected and all outcomes absent. No timer showing a real session has begun.
L04.S02.c002.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c002.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.d001.speaker: maya
L04.S02.d001.text: An answer tool can save time when we get stuck. I would use it as soon as a problem becomes difficult.
L04.S02.d001.visualEn: Brief exact Maya source line. Display time benefit separately from immediate timing; do not infer which tool mode she intends.
L04.S02.d001.anchorHint: An answer tool can save time
L04.S02.d001.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.d001.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S02.c003.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c003.text: Time is relevant to this task. But a possible saving does not settle whether help should be used at the first difficult step. That timing can remain open for discussion.
L04.S02.c003.visualEn: Connect time to the shared aim, then leave the timing decision open. Keep possible as a visible qualifier rather than showing measured minutes saved.
L04.S02.c003.anchorHint: does not settle whether help should be used
L04.S02.c003.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c003.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c004.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c004.text: A phrase such as I see why time matters recognises the reason. I agree that we should use it immediately accepts the proposed action. These are different commitments, even if both sound friendly.
L04.S02.c004.visualEn: Compare two clearly labelled authored phrases, not a viewer transcript. Link each to its exact object: the reason or the proposal.
L04.S02.c004.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c004.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c005.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c005.text: Do not use agreement as a polite disguise for a concern you want to raise. Equally, do not add an acknowledgement you do not mean. A direct, reasoned objection can also be appropriate.
L04.S02.c005.visualEn: Show an optional recognition card, not a mandatory first step. Keep a direct objection route available with equal visual weight.
L04.S02.c005.anchorHint: A direct, reasoned objection can also be appropriate
L04.S02.c005.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c005.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c006.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c006.text: Before comparing replies, consider what you can genuinely recognise here. The time limit is real within the scenario. Whether immediate tool use best serves understanding has not been established.
L04.S02.c006.visualEn: Retain the fixed task time and unresolved proposal. Provide a blank private reflection area rather than an automatically selected personal stance.
L04.S02.c006.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c006.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c007.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c007.text: For this exercise, consider a speaker who values saving time but worries that immediate help could leave too little room for an independent attempt. Which reply expresses both points honestly?
L04.S02.c007.visualEn: State this as an assigned fictional speaking position, not a detected learner belief. Reveal three neutral alternatives at the gate.
L04.S02.c007.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c007.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c008.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c008.text: The peer replies are authored possibilities. They illustrate what the wording introduces into this exchange, not a prediction of Maya’s feelings or a guarantee that one sentence will resolve the difference.
L04.S02.c008.visualEn: Keep proposal state unchanged and label the continuations as authored. No mood meter, applause or permanent good/bad speaker identity.
L04.S02.c008.anchorHint: not a prediction of Maya’s feelings
L04.S02.c008.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c008.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c010.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c010.text: The shared task gives a reason to care about time. It also gives a reason to examine opportunities for reasoning. Recognising one consideration does not remove the other, and neither settles the method on its own.
L04.S02.c010.visualEn: All paths rejoin here once. Reconstruct the two task-related considerations from common facts, without assuming an option was chosen or a peer continuation was heard.
L04.S02.c010.anchorHint: neither settles the method on its own
L04.S02.c010.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c010.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c011.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c011.text: You can say what you recognise and what you question. Keep both specific. Empty praise followed by an unrelated objection does not make the concern clearer merely because it sounds polite.
L04.S02.c011.visualEn: Show two meaningful connections to the source rather than a fixed compliment-then-objection template. No automatic praise or emotional scoring.
L04.S02.c011.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c011.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c012.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c012.text: Acknowledgement is optional. If the reason is already understood, a concise objection may be enough. The aim is an honest, relevant response, not a requirement to begin every disagreement with I agree.
L04.S02.c012.visualEn: Move the acknowledgement card aside as optional. Keep a direct objection route visible; do not imply politeness requires false agreement.
L04.S02.c012.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c012.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c013.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c013.text: For the same assigned position, form a short reply in your own words. Recognise the time concern if useful, then make the reservation clear. Do not claim that immediate help guarantees no learning.
L04.S02.c013.visualEn: Hide complete options and branch models. Keep the task, assigned position and blank private reply area. No simulated recording or copied answer.
L04.S02.c013.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c013.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c014.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c014.text: Think first or speak privately. Nothing is recorded or assessed. The pause is a small opportunity, not a deadline; pause playback if you want longer.
L04.S02.c014.visualEn: Show a quiet private-practice notice. No microphone prompt, timer pressure or progress claim based on time spent.
L04.S02.c014.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c014.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.c015.speaker: coach
L04.S02.c015.text: If you tried a reply, check whether it says what the assigned speaker actually means. If you did not rehearse, you can return later. Next we will make the concern itself more precise.
L04.S02.c015.visualEn: Offer a conditional self-check and neutral next-section title. Keep the source undecided; no automatic advancement, score or claim of improved skill.
L04.S02.c015.anchorHint: make the concern itself more precise
L04.S02.c015.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.c015.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.d101.speaker: learner
L04.S02.d101.text: Yes, that sounds good. Let us use it immediately.
L04.S02.d101.visualEn: Authored alternative A. Show a proposal-level agreement marker inside this branch only, not as the group’s actual adopted plan.
L04.S02.d101.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.d101.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S02.d102.speaker: maya
L04.S02.d102.text: Do you mean we should use the tool whenever a step becomes difficult?
L04.S02.d102.visualEn: Authored Maya check, calm and neutral. She asks what the agreement means; do not imply the group proceeds or that the learner feels pressured.
L04.S02.d102.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.d102.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S02.f101.speaker: coach
L04.S02.f101.text: This can be genuine agreement in another situation. Under the position given here, it conceals the reservation instead of expressing it. A friendly reply is not useful if it states agreement the speaker does not mean.
L04.S02.f101.visualEn: Return to the assigned fictional position and compare its concern with the branch wording. No assessment of the real learner’s beliefs or honesty.
L04.S02.f101.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.f101.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.d201.speaker: learner
L04.S02.d201.text: Saving time matters. I am concerned that using the tool immediately could leave too little room to try a step ourselves.
L04.S02.d201.visualEn: Authored alternative B. Connect the first sentence to the time reason and the second to the possible independent-attempt concern. Preserve could and unselected tool mode.
L04.S02.d201.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.d201.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S02.d202.speaker: maya
L04.S02.d202.text: I want to avoid spending the whole session stuck. What kind of first attempt do you mean?
L04.S02.d202.visualEn: Authored Maya continuation. Restate her time concern and open a question about the alternative. No acceptance, solution or measured benefit is shown.
L04.S02.d202.anchorHint: What kind of first attempt do you mean
L04.S02.d202.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.d202.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S02.f201.speaker: coach
L04.S02.f201.text: This reply recognises a task-related reason and states a possible concern without claiming certainty. Maya asks about the alternative in this example. The difference is now clearer, but no method has been agreed or shown to work.
L04.S02.f201.visualEn: Analyze both meanings with an unresolved next-question card. Do not treat a follow-up question as agreement or praise the viewer’s actual speaking.
L04.S02.f201.anchorHint: no method has been agreed or shown to work
L04.S02.f201.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.f201.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.d301.speaker: learner
L04.S02.d301.text: Using a tool immediately is what lazy learners do.
L04.S02.d301.visualEn: Authored wording under examination, not the narrator’s judgement. Put the personal label in a separate interpretation lane; never attach lazy as a character identity.
L04.S02.d301.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.d301.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S02.d302.speaker: maya
L04.S02.d302.text: I am trying to use the time well. Can we discuss when the tool would help?
L04.S02.d302.visualEn: Authored Maya response, composed rather than humiliated or angry. Bring attention back to timing and purpose; no prediction of universal emotional reaction.
L04.S02.d302.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.d302.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S02.f301.speaker: coach
L04.S02.f301.text: This labels people instead of explaining the concern about timing. Maya’s words do not establish laziness. A useful objection could instead identify the opportunity for independent reasoning that immediate help might reduce.
L04.S02.f301.visualEn: Remove the personal label from the factual claim area. Return to the task-related concern with conditional wording; do not equate tool use with a learner trait.
L04.S02.f301.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S02.f301.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S02.h101.purpose: Privately distinguish a relevant reason from an undecided action.
L04.S02.h101.visualEn: Keep the source and task visible, with no options or answer model during the hold. Do not infer a belief or response from elapsed time.

L04.S02.h102.purpose: Privately formulate an honest response to the assigned position.
L04.S02.h102.visualEn: Keep the response area blank. Do not supply a model during the hold or infer that the viewer spoke.

L04.I01.prompt: Suppose you value saving time but have the stated reservation about immediate help. Which reply expresses both honestly?

options.label: Yes, that sounds good. Let us use it immediately.
Saving time matters. I am concerned that using the tool immediately could leave too little room to try a step ourselves.
Using a tool immediately is what lazy learners do.

L04.I01.skipNote: Comparison skipped. No belief, response or understanding was recorded; continue to the shared explanation.
L04.I01.baseline: Restore exact Maya d001, the fictional task, unselected hint/full-answer mode, and the assigned speaking position. The proposal is unadopted and untested. Each option is a separate authored continuation. Retry removes all prior branch reactions and any branch-specific agreement marker. Watch shows B only after eight seconds. Practice waits indefinitely; Continue or Skip enters c010 once without inferred correctness or personal beliefs.
L04.I01.branchOutcome: Authored fictional continuation, not a prediction or universal reaction.

boundary: Use formal explanation and short examples. No perpetual three-person scene; no school, exam, policy or assessed-learner claim.
